checks.name: logs in at the hub and the peer
D1 first click: the host opens beside the dashboard (host-created), the agent waits
D2 the Operator drags the host tab into the LEFT window
D3 the queued agent A opens in LEFT the moment the host is moved
D4 C (remote peer) opens in LEFT
D5 re-click A: left-focused — A is now the ACTIVE tab of LEFT (chrome.tabs), not reloaded
D6 after F5 on the dashboard: re-click C raises it (the remote tab is LEFT's active tab)
D7 after an ERROR-PAGE reload (new browsing-context group): A is still handled in LEFT, steered not raised, no tab left behind in RIGHT
D8 …and a NEW agent B still opens in LEFT
